name: Chelo Kebab
subtitle: minced kebabs over buttered rice with a raw egg yolk, the Bombay club dish

ingredients.note: squeeze it, or the kebabs fall apart
traditionally raw on the hot rice; cook them if you prefer

ingredients.qty: a pinch, soaked in warm milk

prepNotes: Borrowed from Iranian chelo kabab and kept alive by Bombay's Irani restaurants. The butter, the saffron rice and the yolk are all part of it.
A raw yolk on hot rice is traditional. If you would rather not, a soft-cooked yolk does the same job.

steps.text: Mix the mince with the squeezed onion, ginger, garlic, pepper, chilli powder and salt. Knead 5 minutes until sticky.
steps.tip: The kneading develops the bind. Under-worked mince crumbles off the skewer.

steps.text: Rest the mixture in the refrigerator 30 minutes, then shape onto skewers in long flat kebabs.
Cook the rice, drain, and fold through half the butter and the saffron milk.
Grill or pan-fry the kebabs on high 4 minutes a side until charred outside and just cooked within.
Serve the kebabs on the rice, dot with the remaining butter and slide a yolk on top of each plate.

storage: The kebabs keep 2 days refrigerated. Cook the rice fresh and add the yolk at the table, never in advance.
